200.description: The ranked proposals, each with its token and expiry.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when this answer is the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key, method, path and body; absent on a first execution.

schema.description: Response body of the read routes. The concrete DTO shapes are pinned by the golden/contract tests in internal/adapters/inbound/http (testdata) and the godog suite in features/; this document pins paths, parameters, statuses and the error contract.

400.description: The request itself is invalid (missing/invalid parameters or body), or, on a POST, the Idempotency-Key header is missing (idempotency-key-required) or malformed (idempotency-key-invalid).
